title: 语调
goal: 判断一句话应使用的语调；判断句中未完成处的语调。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 判断一句话应使用的语调
判断句中未完成处的语调

body.p: 语调是意群里音高的变化，表示话说完了、还没说完或在询问。本课用 ↑ 表示升调，↓ 表示降调。箭头只标意群末尾的变化，不是全句逐词升降。

body.box:
The room is ready. ↓
Is the room ready? ↑

body.p: 陈述、询问、列举和确认各有常见的语调。选语调看说话的目的，不只看标点。书面题会写明说话的目的。题目不要求听辨录音的实际音高。

cards.title: 句末语调
rows: 报告一件已完成的事：The printer is ready. ↓
普通的询问：Where is the printer? ↓
询问不知道的事：Is the printer ready? ↑
说话人不确定：The printer is ready, isn’t it? ↑
说话人已经确定：The printer is ready, isn’t it? ↓
没听清，再问一遍：Where is the printer? ↑
cards.note: 同一句反意疑问句可升可降。升降看说话人有没有把握，不看句子是肯定还是否定。

cards.title: 未完成处的语调
rows: 前项常升，最后一项降，表示清单结束。
We need pencils ↑, rulers ↑, and erasers ↓.
已说出的最后一项用升调，表示后面还有。
从句末可用升调或平调延续，主句末降。
When the paint dries ↑, remove the tape ↓.
条件从句末用升调，表示后面还有主句。
If the cable fits ↑, connect the monitor ↓.
让步从句末用升调，表示后面还有主句，不是提问。
Although the room is small ↑, the desks fit ↓.
句中的升调表示没说完，句末的升调表示求证。
After the call ↑, send the form ↓. / Is it ready? ↑
cards.note: 前置从句末也可以用平调或降升调。本课的选择题用升调代表这一类读法。

body.box:
Context: The speaker has not checked the cupboard and genuinely wants confirmation.
The spare cups are in the cupboard, aren’t they?
Choose the tag ending and its meaning.
1. Falling; agreement is expected.
2. Rising; confirmation is requested.
3. Rising; the list will continue.
4. Falling; the location is being announced.

body.p: has not checked 和 genuinely wants confirmation 说明说话人不确定。附加问句用升调表示求证，答案是第二项。同一句用降调，表示期待对方认同。

groups.text: The speaker gives a finished, neutral announcement: The shuttle has arrived.

items.stem: Which ending matches the stated purpose?
items.why: The shuttle has arrived 是完整的中性陈述，用降调。

groups.text: The speaker genuinely asks: Has the parcel arrived?

items.stem: Which description fits the usual ending?
options: Rising; a yes/no question seeking information
items.why: Has the parcel arrived 是一般疑问句，真心询问时用升调。

groups.text: The speaker asks for a place without surprise or repetition: Where is the spare key?

items.stem: Which ending fits this neutral wh-question?
options: Rising; a request to repeat unheard words
Falling; an ordinary request for information
Rising; an unfinished sequence of places
Falling; an assertion that the key is spare
items.why: Where is the spare key 是普通的特殊疑问句，用降调。材料说明这不是没听清后的复问。

groups.text: The speaker is certain the hall is quiet and expects agreement: The hall is quiet, isn’t it?

items.stem: Which tag ending matches that attitude?
options: Falling; a location question is being asked
items.why: 说话人已经确定，期待对方认同，附加问句用降调。

groups.text: This is the complete list: Bring clips, tape, and string.

items.stem: Which sequence follows the closed-list pattern?
items.why: 完整的列举前两项用升调，最后的 string 用降调结束。

groups.text: When the alarm stops, the technician will reset the panel.

items.stem: Which pair marks continuation and final completion?
items.why: When 从句在前，话还没说完，stops 处用升调。主句末 panel 处用降调结束。

groups.text: The speaker begins a longer list and will add more items: helmets, gloves …

items.stem: What does a rise after gloves indicate?
options: The speaker expects agreement with a tag.
items.why: 材料说明清单还会继续，gloves 后的升调表示没说完。

groups.text: If the frame is secure, the exhibition can open.

items.stem: Which clause boundary can carry a continuation rise?
items.why: If the frame is secure 是条件从句，secure 后用升调，引出主句。

groups.text: A curator neutrally reports a completed fact: The display is finished.

items.stem: Which ending matches the stated function?
options: Rising; a list is still open
Falling; a complete statement is made
Rising; a yes/no answer is sought
Falling; a wh-question requests a detail
items.why: The display is finished 是中性完整陈述，降调表示完成。

groups.text: A visitor asks about an unknown fact: Is the upper gallery open?

items.stem: Which ending matches the ordinary yes/no pattern?
options: Rising; a request to confirm a fact
items.why: Is the upper gallery open 是一般疑问句，真实询问时常用升调。

groups.text: The speaker asks without surprise: Why was the rehearsal postponed?

items.stem: Which ending follows the neutral wh-question pattern?
options: Rising; unheard words are being repeated
Rising; a list of reasons remains unfinished
Falling; the postponement is being announced
items.why: Why was … postponed 是普通的特殊疑问句，问的是原因，用降调。

groups.text: Compare two uses of "The path is safe, isn’t it?" First, the speaker is unsure. Second, the speaker is confident and expects agreement.

items.stem: Which pair matches the tag endings in order?
items.why: 第一种是真心求证，用升调。第二种是期待认同，用降调。

groups.text: The complete kit contains a compass, a whistle, and a torch.

items.stem: Which sequence closes the three-item list?
items.why: 完整的列举在 compass、whistle 处用升调，torch 处用降调结束。

groups.text: After the adhesive sets, the model can be moved.

items.stem: Which pair shows continuation followed by completion?
items.why: After the adhesive sets 是放在前面的时间从句，sets 处用升调。主句末 moved 处用降调结束。

groups.text: Although the trial was brief, the team collected useful observations.

items.stem: What does a continuation rise after brief signal?
options: The speaker is asking whether the trial was brief.
The speaker has completed a list of observations.
The speaker expects agreement with a tag question.
The main statement following the concession is still to come.
items.why: Although 从句先说让步，brief 处的升调表示后面还有主句，不是提问。

groups.text: The coordinator says "badges, lanyards …" and has more supplies to name.

items.stem: Which interpretation fits a rise after lanyards?
options: The supply list is now complete.
The supply list is still continuing.
A yes/no answer about lanyards is required.
Agreement with a negative tag is expected.
items.why: has more supplies to name 说明清单没完，lanyards 后的升调表示还有下一项。
